slices.behaviour: The seven findings of the third review: authorship is named positively as the stages where a ticket is worked, so a return at deliver or a reopen at delivered is not authorship and a ticket cannot be left unable to leave review; the gate reads changes_agent_action from the ticket frontmatter as well as the clarify record; the review draft asks the gate rather than carrying a copy of its reasoning; the pack counts from where the plan was last accepted rather than within an attempt, so a return does not discard a declaration; and the skill describes both triggers, the assistants vocabulary and the session rule as the code applies them
slices.failure_reason: AssertionError: {'claude', 'codex'} != {'claude'} for a return at the deliver stage and for a reopen at delivered (H1), HarnessError: the review comes from the other assistant raised for the review the gate demands (H1 at the gate), HarnessError not raised for a ticket whose frontmatter declares an agent action (H2), AttributeError: module 'harness.gates' has no attribute 'needs_two_reviewers' (H3), 'Slice 3' not found in the pack after a return (H4), and 'changes_agent_action', '[actors] assistants' absent from the skill with "this attempt's own records" still in it (H5, H6)
